role: Comparación anual suplementaria; la visual primaria conserva la ventana retrospectiva de seis meses.
population: worker_type='Employee' AND employee_type='Regular' AND active_status=1 at the monthly cutoff, with usable employee_id
assumption: An event is a distinct employee_id + manager_change_date key with manager_change=1, observed no later than the snapshot. Repeated monthly observations of the same key count once.
publication_rule: Publish absolute counts and percentages; every displayed bucket must have n >= 30; no identifiers or individual records.
